title: Owner decides: five core rules missing from root AGENTS.md
goal: Root AGENTS.md either carries each core rule or states its exemption
acceptance: The owner chooses, per rule (failing test is evidence; replacing a feature removes its state; testing the joins; privacy; a plan or promise becomes records), to add it or record its exemption, and how to keep the audit route within its rule-load budget
The decision is recorded in B-128; any rule text lands in its own PR
escalation: A dropped or reworded safety requirement goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: an owner decision on five rules. Not a measurement.
